subject: Fix swordfight RNG draw divergence (mislabeled VipIdleRemark cluster, ~80)
description: From #25: the rng:VipIdleRemark cluster (80 traces) is a classifier artifact — it groups by FIRST RNG site in the divergent frame; the VipIdleRemark/The16thFrame draws match. The actual missing/extra draws are swordfight draws: UpdateSwordfightDistance (offsets 1807002/1807253), ReceiveSwordDamage (1746896/1747024), EvaluateSwordfight (1814391), FindPositionForTableSwordfight (~1804390), plus SwordDamageProtection extras. The offset→function map came from addr2line on original-code/build/native-full/robin. Compare the Rust swordfight distance/damage/evaluate draw sites and their gates against C++ arm by arm (docs/TURN_ARMS.md methodology).
